{{Quote|Now we may continue Master Halsey's memorial service. Being used as a pawn to slay his fellows would have grieved him terribly&hellip;''"<br />"''Perhaps his soul will rest easier, Obi-Wan&mdash;knowing you prevented that!|Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Sabotage" />}}
A '''funeral''' was held in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]], who had been killed on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] by the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] during a [[Devaron massacre/Legends|battle]] at the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]].

==The funeral==
[[File:Funeral_of_Halsey.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Obi-Wan Kenobi saves the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attending the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]]]]
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] wished to kill those at the funeral, so [[Unidentified Weequay agent 1|three]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 2|Weequay]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 3|agents]] carefully placed a [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] bomb inside the coffin. Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered this and removed the bomb before [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] could [[Cremation/Legends|light]] the coffin, thus saving all those present.
